Name: Ir-nahash
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed sites include Dayr Nakhkhas and Khirbet en Nahas
Description: A town in Judah's genealogies, listed as founded by Tehinnah, father of Ir-nahash, among the families of Rechah.
BiblicalSignificance: Ir-nahash survives only as a name in a genealogy, one of the small towns whose founders Judah remembered.
